package.description: Creates a virtual monitor in Windows that functions just like a physical display.

en-US.description: Creates a virtual monitor in Windows that functions just like a physical display.
en-US.longDescription: This project creates a virtual monitor in Windows that functions just like a physical display. It is particularly useful for applications such as streaming, virtual reality, screen recording, and headless servers—systems that operate without a physical display attached.
en-US.name: Virtual Display Driver
